input.change_text: Hardened "Open in editor" actions against command injection from untrusted filenames

output.subject: Command injection via untrusted filenames in `Open in editor` actions
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-code` 2.1.110+ to harden the `Open in editor` action against command injection from untrusted filenames. Pre-fix, crafted filenames could execute shell commands when opened — relevant when reviewing PRs or untrusted repos.
